'''Syla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] daughter of [[Tyvar]] and [[Chiana]] living on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Her father was a former [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agent and during the [[Conquest of Makeb]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hanthor]] of the Sith Empire was forced to send a retrieval team for Tyvar and his family, relocating them to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
